result.detail: This attempt fixes the refused attempt 1, which listed a run that was never recorded. tool_runs now lists only the recorded VeriTriage session run-0005. The three repro files keep the content of attempt 1, which I rechecked by hand against the RTL timing: mid-bit sampling at negedges N3 + 4k, and busy high from p1 to p45 on a clean design. Open gaps: VeriTriage was run only on the combined set (30% confidence, unknown_failure), not on each log alone. The failures have not been rerun with the same seed to rule out flakiness. A per-log veritriage.investigate call would strengthen the bucketing. The platform's simulator.run expect=fail gate decides whether each repro reproduces.; submitted on attempt 2, after prj-c391b404ed:triage#t1
